sourceFile.description: The {@link Genai.SourceFile} that the #passage belongs to.

sourceAttribution.description: The result from attribution with corroboration for this source relation.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

from.description: The {@link Genai.Query.Result} that this relation is associated with.

fromStep.description: The {@link Genai.Agent.DynamicTrajectory.Step} that this relation is associated with.

passageUiDisplayIndex.description:
Stores the order in which cited passages appear in the UI.

An index of -1 means that the llm did not use this passage and therefore it did not appear in the UI.

NOTE: this is 1-indexed

title:
Relationship indicating the {@link Genai.SourcePassage} was retrieved by the Query
Chain as a relevant file for the {@link Genai.Query.Result#searchQuery}
and that the passage was used by the language model as a source in the
{@link Genai.Query.Result#rationale}.
name: Genai.Query.ResultToSourceFileRelation
